This page is the evidence catalog for the model. It is generated from
`references.bib`, which is the single source of truth for source identity,
access status and current model use.

## How to Read the Catalog

Every record has one **access** class and one **model-use** class.

| Dimension | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Access | **Public** | The evidence record is publicly accessible. |
| Access | **Controlled internal** | Reproduction requires access to a controlled project source. |
| Access | **Access unresolved** | The exact accessible source record is incomplete. |
| Model use | **Adopted** | Supports an adopted input, method, boundary or model-relevant claim. |
| Model use | **Validation only** | Tests or contextualises a result but is not the adopted model input. |
| Model use | **Background only** | Retained for context and not used by the current model documentation. |
| Model use | **Use unresolved** | No final model use has been established. |

Public reproducibility means that a reader can obtain the cited evidence
independently. Controlled-internal reproducibility means that the calculation
can be reconstructed only by someone with authorised access to the underlying
project source. A controlled source is not independently reproducible merely
because its provenance is named.

An unresolved record cannot support a final model result. It remains in the
catalog so the missing source or model-use decision stays visible rather than
being replaced by an unsupported assumption.

::: {#evidence-status-summary}
Evidence status totals are added from the controlled bibliography metadata
when the page loads.
:::
